description: Machine-readable feature state list. Single source of truth for scope. State transitions are gated by verification: a feature only becomes 'passing' when its verification command actually passes. See docs/FEATURES.md for rules.

features.behavior: CLI accepts `npx humb <database-url>`, auto-detects the database engine from the target (Postgres today), and starts the local server.
Launching Humb opens the browser UI which shows the database connection status.
Postgres adapter introspects schemas, tables, columns, indexes, and row counts.
UI shows a database navigation tree (schemas/tables) and table metadata.
UI displays a paginated page of rows for a selected table.
Read-only SQL query runner executes SELECT-style statements and rejects mutations.
Local server exposes health and runtime diagnostics endpoints for agent verification.
